Name: New NPC Cain and Nightcat 1.6 - Updated English Translation
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from muxuelaiyin, I've translated their mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28170]New NPC Cain and Nightcat 1.6[/url] to English. 

One night while in the Secret Woods, you discover a mysterious crystal. When you investigate, you find yourself in a glen full of roses...and an old manor? The master of this manor is a mysterious man named Cain. As you get to know him, you notice he doesn't seem quite human...

This translation includes all updated 1.6 dialogue. Simply drag and drop the files over the original mod's assets and allow to merge/overwrite.

Enjoy!
